Name: Marshmallows in Stardew - Legacy JSON Assets
Author: callysquared
Description:
I have updated the Marshmallow content of this mod to use Content Patcher and released it as a new mod here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44968]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44968[/url]
Currently it does not include the chocolate content, but I may add that in future. 


An exotic new paddy crop has arrived to Stardew Valley: The Marsh Mallow!
These fragrant flowers are the basis of a number of sweet treats you can cook up, that are sure to be a hit around town!

Adds:
Marsh Mallow flower, a paddy-type crop
3 kinds of Marshmallows, cook-able/purchasable sweet treats
Chocolate! Cacao trees and cacao pods.
A further assortment of treats to be discovered, with buffs!


Recipes can be purchased from the various merchants of Stardew Valley, and Calico Desert. They will begin to show once you've reached 10000g total earnings.

Cacao pods can be roasted in a furnace to make Refined Cocoa.

Original version had the main Marshmallow recipe purchasable from Sandy, but I've added another where it's purchasable from Gus instead.


If updating to 1.2.4, remove any existing versions from your mods folder first.

Requirements:
Stardew Valley 1.4+
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assests[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿

Screenshots include
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url]﻿

Big shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url]for making adding new crops and items so easy!
